title: hostgroup.massadd
description: Simultaneously add multiple related objects to all the given host groups.

groups.description: Host groups to be updated. The host groups must have only the groupid property defined. Parameter behavior: required.

hosts.description: Hosts to add to all host groups. The hosts must have only the hostid property defined.

hostGroupRef.description: Reference to an existing host group by groupid only.

hostRef.description: Reference to an existing host by hostid only.
